action.objective: Verify d1a4 (Qxa4), the broad-search top candidate, at full depth to see if the pawn recovery is sound.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 found d1a4 best (-94 exact) with line Qxa4 dxc3 bxc3, recovering the a4 pawn while keeping material balanced. h1g1 was -123 with an upper bound, less trustworthy. Before committing I must run single-candidate verification on d1a4 per contract; d4c3 and dxc3 plans need checking against Black's threats.
